'''"Downside"''' was a slum area of [[Fabrillan]], the [[Capital/Legends|capital city]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Malthor]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the Reigat [[Bakku]] lived in it.
